title: Formal-moduli excision for Hochschild and cyclic homology of rational algebra-valued functors with H-unital tangent algebras over characteristic-zero fields
author: Benjamin Hennion
difficulty_reason: Ordinary Wodzicki excision does not identify these maps after rational formalisation of a varying pre-moduli algebra. The author constructs and compares the relevant bar and Hochschild filtrations, proves that their successive cofibers vanish under the formalisation functor using H-unitality, and supplies the pointed nonunital tensor-compatibility needed in that argument. These steps establish the alpha equivalences and, through the separately complete composite-map argument, the claimed beta equivalences.

Theorem3.1.1(b), with k a characteristic-zero field, algebra-valued Q-linear pre-formal-moduli functor A, its pointed augmentation fiber, and H-unital tangent algebra ell_Q(A). Exact alpha/beta comparison maps and both Hochschild/cyclic conclusions retained. Entire new filtration/excision and formalization monoidality proofs read. Lurie–Pridham formal moduli classification and standard presentable-category adjunction/generator results are explicit prior research foundations. Lemma2.1.14 says its straightforward proof is left to the reader, but supplies all adjunction/composite formulas; this is bounded formal adjunction verification rather than the selected novel excision core. No unproved Goodwillie-derivative comparison from Remark3.1.6 or positive-characteristic/general-base conjectural extension selected; K-theory corollary not separately counted.
